The table should be like this fields 
CREATE TABLE Education (
    ID INT PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY,

EntityID INT NOT NULL, -- ApplicationID/AccountID 
EntityTypeID INT NOT NULL, -- ApplicationID(200)/AccountID(201)
